summary: Manage agents as a measured portfolio of capabilities and authorities rather than a static organization chart.

items.text: Maintain a role card with allowed tools, model, budget, evidence requirements, escalation path and recent calibrated performance by task class.
Route first to the smallest topology likely to succeed; add specialists only when an uncertainty, dependency or independent check warrants them.
Run periodic ablations against single-agent and human-assisted baselines to retire roles whose coordination cost exceeds their measured contribution.
